# no-scenario-outlines-without-examples

Require Scenario Outlines to have Examples rows.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | no | no | none |

Finds Scenario Outlines with no Examples rows, which never run.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-scenario-outlines-without-examples": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario Outline: never runs
```
